description: This file defines a Java class 'UpdateTemplateCommandHandler' which handles the update operation for a 'TEMPLATE' entity within the Apache Fineract project. It implements a command handler interface, is annotated as a service with transaction management, and delegates the update logic to the TemplateDomainService.

classes.name: UpdateTemplateCommandHandler
classes.description: A service class that handles the update command for templates, implementing the NewCommandSourceHandler interface and delegating update logic to the TemplateDomainService.

methods.name: UpdateTemplateCommandHandler
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the service with the TemplateDomainService dependency.

methods.name: processCommand
methods.description: Processes the update command for a template, delegating to the template service's updateTemplate method.
